title: ALGORITHMIC TRADEOFFS, APPLIED NLP, AND THE STATE-OF-THE-ART FALLACY

bias_targets.methodology: Generating synthetic college admission essays using LLMs, extracting Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC) features, and applying a trained machine learning classifier to predict the apparent parental education level (first-generation vs. continuing generation) and high school type (public vs. private) to see if AI outputs disproportionately align with higher social status backgrounds.
Using a classifier trained on human college admissions essays to predict whether LLM-generated essays align stylistically with students who have above-median or below-median GPAs.
